response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM c) AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff FROM s), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rk FROM d) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, diff FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff DESC
